lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: سَجَىٰ is in the derivative form: سَجى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
س/ج/ي   s–j–y (of the night) to become silent, quiet or still, to calm down, to become tranquil, placid. Of this root, onlyسَجى sajā occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
سَجى sajā u [v. intrans.] to be quiet, to be still, to be tranquil, to be serene

(93:2) وَاللَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَى and by the night, when it grows still.
